answer_1.quote: News Headline Generation is an under-explored subtask of text summarization .

answer_2.quote: We use Distinct-1 and Distinct-2 (the higher the better) to evaluate diversity, which report the degree of the diversity by calculating the number of distinct unigrams and bigrams in generated headlines for each article.

answer_4.quote: Three experts are asked to judge whether each headline could be used as the headline of the news.
answer_4.guideline: If more than two experts believe that it can be used as the headline of the news, then this headline is considered qualified.
